translation: If, after it has somewhat healed, one immediately engages in labor, causing the end of the hang bone (胻骨) to lean inward, then the inner ankle protrudes and swells large; if it leans outward, then the outer ankle protrudes and swells large, with the blood vessels congested and congealed, weakness in walking, and the sole of the foot leaning to one side, which is quite difficult to regulate and treat. Therefore one must wait until the qi and blood are fully free-flowing and completely restored before one may move about. <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) (seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Dingtong San</ins> (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散) (seen in the injury of the shanjiao bone) <ins>Haitongpi</ins> (Erythrina bark, 海桐皮) (seen in the injury of the two cheekbones) <ins>Jianbu Huqian Wan</ins> (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸) (seen in the injury of the hip bone).
